# MRTK assets

Button meshes, materials, the `Mixed Reality Toolkit/Standard` shader and select sounds that Galaxy Explorer's
content uses, kept from Microsoft's Mixed Reality Toolkit v2 (2.0.0-RC1) when the toolkit itself was removed for
the Meta Quest 3 port. Asset GUIDs are unchanged, so existing references still resolve.
